request.goal: A 20-second square post that shows how the oak bowl is made, from the raw blank to the oiled bowl. Trim the pauses.

plan.title: Raw Blank to Oiled Oak Bowl
plan.caption: Raw blank to oiled bowl in seconds — turning, sanding and oiling, pauses trimmed.

segments.label: Raw blank

segments.label: Reading the grain
segments.reason: Holds on grain pattern detail while narration describes grain direction. Keeps spoken sentence [12.2-14.5] intact and trims pauses.

segments.label: Shaping cuts

segments.label: Sanding
segments.reason: Continued top-down bowl view with smoother surface and tool presence, marking the smoothing stage. Keeps spoken sentence [24.5-28.1] intact and trims pauses; start moved back to sentence start at 24.4 s.

segments.label: Oiling color
segments.reason: Bowl shows warmer deeper tone and soft sheen on dark planks, marking color change stage. Keeps spoken sentence [32.3-34.9] intact and trims pauses.

segments.label: Finished bowl
segments.reason: Final top-down view of completed bowl centered on dark planks with clear grain rings. Keeps spoken sentence [35.8-39.1] intact and trims pauses.

review.verdict: Neat 17.7s arc from ring close-up at 0s to glossy bowl at 14.3s reads clearly, but static hold at 0-5s sags and gray tip bottom-right at 8-11.7s still reads as cutting during sanding line.
review.caption_suggestion: Wet oak blank to warm oiled bowl — grain, shaping, sanding and oil in under 18 seconds.
strengths: Opens at 0.2s with raw oak blank still wet and heavy over bold growth rings, immediate material entry.
Shaping at 5.2s shows bowl hollowing with shavings flying as voice says long steady cuts, picture and words line up.
Oil payoff at 11.8s shows deepening brown color as voice says brings out the color, clear before-after.

fixes.what: Add gentle push-in over ring close-up at 0-5s and over bowl view at 5-17.7s so static holds breathe
Anchor sanding line at 8-11.7s where gray tip sits bottom-right with a top label naming the sanding stage so bowl reads as sanding

review.verdict: Tight and clear square story that works: wet oak rings at 0s hook, steady lathe cuts at 6s and sanding label at 9s carry the middle, and the oiled glowing bowl at 12-17s lands the raw-to-ready arc with readable captions throughout.
review.caption_suggestion: Wet oak blank to glowing food-safe bowl in under 18s — watch the grain come alive.
strengths: Opening 0-2.7s close-up of raw oak rings while voice says still wet and heavy instantly establishes material
Lathe shaping 5.2-8.0s shows bowl spinning with shavings flying while voice says long steady cuts, process is legible
Oiling 11.8-14.4s shows bowl warming on dark boards while voice says brings out the color, payoff is visible
